_comment: Werewolf-only overlay (helper). The lycan curse (D-248): a bite alone lands phase 0 permanently on its own timetable; later phases are gated on the MOON (`moon_min`), so the change only deepens as the moon fills. Genitals sit in phase 1 so the cycle drives them (heat). Phase 0 is deliberately tight — fangs, claws, tongue: the mark the bite leaves.
